# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with retries and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main as run_cycle.py
    participant ITR as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant TCR as TDDCycleRunner
    participant PLP as PythonLanguagePod
    participant WA as WorkerAgent
    participant PO as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PR as PodmanRunner
    participant IP as IncrementalPlanner
    participant PM as PlaybookManager
    participant EL as ExperimentLogger
    participant LC as LLMClient
    participant RF as Reflector
    participant CR as Curator

    Main->>LC: create LLMClient(provider, model)
    Main->>PM: get_or_create_playbook(playbook_id)
    Main->>PM: add_bullet(playbook_id, BulletCreate)
    Main->>WA: WorkerAgent(llm, playbook_manager)
    Main->>EL: ExperimentLogger(playbook_version)
    Main->>IP: IncrementalPlanner(llm_client, ...)
    Main->>PR: PodmanRunner(container_name)
    Main->>PR: start()
    Main->>PO: PodmanOrchestrator(runner, work_dir)
    Main->>PLP: PythonLanguagePod(worker, output_dir, orchestrator)
    Main->>ITR: IterativeTDDRunner(pod, planner, ...)
    Main->>ITR: run_from_feature(feature_path)

    loop for each cycle
        ITR->>IP: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number, gherkin_context)
        IP->>LC: generate(prompt)
        LC-->>IP: response
        IP-->>ITR: TestIncrement

        ITR->>TCR: run(spec)
        TCR->>PLP: run_red(spec)
        PLP->>WA: generate_test(spec, existing_code)
        WA->>LC: generate(prompt)
        LC-->>WA: response
        WA-->>PLP: test_code
        PLP->>PO: pulse(files)
        PO->>PR: send_pulse(files)
        PR-->>PO: PulseResult
        PO-->>PLP: PhaseResult
        PLP-->>TCR: red_result

        alt RED aborted
            TCR-->>ITR: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                TCR->>PLP: run_green(spec)
                PLP->>WA: generate_implementation(spec, error_output, test_code)
                WA->>LC: generate(prompt)
                LC-->>WA: response
                WA-->>PLP: impl_code
                PLP->>PO: pulse(files)
                PO->>PR: send_pulse(files)
                PR-->>PO: PulseResult
                PO-->>PLP: PhaseResult
                PLP-->>TCR: green_result
                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else
                    TCR->>TCR: error_feedback = green_result.output
                end
            end

            alt GREEN failed
                TCR-->>ITR: CycleResult(success=False)
            else GREEN passed
                TCR->>PLP: run_refactor(spec)
                PLP->>WA: generate_refactor(spec, current_code)
                WA->>LC: generate(prompt)
                LC-->>WA: response
                WA-->>PLP: refactored_code
                PLP->>PO: pulse(files)
                PO->>PR: send_pulse(files)
                PR-->>PO: PulseResult
                PO-->>PLP: PhaseResult
                PLP-->>TCR: refactor_result

                TCR->>RF: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                RF->>LC: generate(prompt)
                LC-->>RF: response
                RF-->>TCR: ReflectorOutput

                TCR->>CR: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id, task_context)
                CR->>LC: generate(prompt)
                LC-->>CR: response
                CR-->>TCR: CuratorOutput

                TCR->>PM: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                PM-->>TCR: added_bullets

                TCR-->>ITR: CycleResult(success=True, learned_bullets)
            end
        end

        TCR->>EL: log_tdd_cycle(cycle_number, ...)
    end

    ITR-->>Main: IterativeResult
    Main->>PR: stop()
```
